page.overview:
Who is Broly?

240 cm (7'10"; Ikari form) 290 cm (9'6"; possible height of his SSJ form) 300 cm (9'10"; FP SSJ)

Unlike his counterpart from the Dragon Ball Z movies, Broly is truly a quiet, reserved Saiyan who cares deeply for his friends and loved ones, only letting loose his violent instincts upon being entrenched in fierce combat. Initially serving as the main protagonist and misguided central antagonist of Dragon Ball Super: Broly, he has since become the newest rival to fellow Saiyans Goku and Vegeta.

To distinguish him from the other Broly, this Broly is often referred to as Broly: BR in video games and other media.

Broly is based off the previous Broly from Dragon Ball Z's Broly film trilogy.

Also known as: Legendary Super Saiyan.
